skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Fragrance From the Branches
skins.content: 0011 New Arrivals/Fragrance From the Branches. Clean-cut, form-fitting skirt, given an extra touch with matching accessories. The soft felt jacket keeps the wearer warm in the chill of early spring.
skins.quote: The touch of the spring breeze brushes the blossoms on the branches. The touch of wine brushes the furrowed brow.

skins.name: Summer Flowers FA641
skins.content: MARTHE [Coral Coast] Summer Flowers Series FA641. Brings out a girl's figure and physique using all-natural materials. Pursue this summer's hottest trend.
skins.quote: Light and Cart are engrossed in scoffing lotus seeds, and Helmet and Drill are piled atop each other for a nap. Blacknight's mind is far away, most likely reminiscing on summer in the barrens.
